absent: Full definitions of traversal, tree, node, metadata and write state structures beyond the fields touched by these fragments.
Bit positions, numeric values and widths of encoding masks, shifts, flags, capacities and error codes.
Computation of store categories, preallocation, splitting, rebalancing, spanning writes and gap propagation beyond direct replacement.
Complete locking and reclamation protocol outside debug checks, including writer exclusion, grace handling and lifetime rules.
Semantics of unrouted helpers for walking, ascent details, leaf gap computation and interval test setup such as search counts and random ranges.
Exact overflow, underflow and error recovery expectations for callers and the meaning of pause versus active for all entry points.

findings.text: Public forward iterator moves a traversal cursor to the next position bounded by a caller limit, first refreshing debug lock state, then normalizing a non active cursor, then advancing through slots and reporting termination once the limit is reached.
Public range store builds a traversal over a caller interval, rejects reserved encodings and inverted bounds, then performs one serialized write under the tree lock and returns the resulting status.

Allocation aware store preparation and decoding of parent address, parent slot position and parent category are visible beyond the defining fragment and may be used by other units in the same dossier.

Cursor lifecycle separates start, active, paused, absent, singleton root and overflow phases with dedicated tests; a cursor outside active or start may be returned to start for a fresh walk, and a cursor leaving overflow or underflow becomes active again only while its position remains inside its recorded interval, otherwise it returns to start.

A walk beginning at start validates locks, records a full span and then distinguishes an empty tree, a singleton tree answered directly for the initial position, and a populated tree that descends through pivots while narrowing the interval until a leaf is reached, finally publishing position, limits and enclosing link; observation of reclaimed storage resets the walk.

Preparation for forward stepping rearms paused or previously terminated cursors, treats singleton trees as a short two phase sequence and reports prior errors as finished; stepping consumes remaining pivots in the current node, otherwise climbs to a successor and signals overflow when the caller limit is met or no successor exists, restarting transparently after reclaimed storage.

Store preparation preallocates write state, retries under allocation pressure, propagates encoded errors and always releases cursor resources; completion then dispatches on a previously chosen category covering direct replacement, append, slot update, node update, spanning update, split, rebalance, fresh root creation and singleton replacement, refreshing gap summaries when direct replacement changes occupancy and treating an unexpected category as fatal.

Debug checking exists only under lock debugging; active cursors compare the current lock sequence against a stored value, initialization records the current sequence or captures a grace token when no lock is held, external trees use an external debug object while others use the embedded lock object, and held status consults the matching holder test.

Access to the tree root and to indexed child slots uses read side critical section dereference guarded by the same held test employed for validation, with a cursor level reader forwarding to the tree level slot reader.

Observed cursor state comprises tree reference, current encoded link, status, depth, current position, interval end, enclosing minimum and maximum, live length, slot offset, stored grace snapshot, stored lock sequence and chosen store category; descent and ascent maintain the enclosing interval and refresh position, limits, offset and length on each move.

Node storage is selected by category: allocation tracking and plain range forms each expose pivots, slots and metadata, a copy form exposes pivots, slots and gaps, and a dense form exposes only slots; leaf identity follows category ordering, live length derives from metadata or pivot occupancy bounded by a per category capacity, and gap storage exists only for allocation tracking and copy forms with the widest position recorded in metadata.

Child links combine a node address with a small category tag and marker bits, with helpers to obtain a plain node, to clear the root marker and to build a tagged link; the tag is recovered by shift and mask, root identity is tested through a flag in the parent word, parent address, slot index and shift width are decoded with separate masks for narrow and wide parents, parent category decoding consults allocation mode, and pivot lookup beyond capacity falls back to the recorded maximum.

Reclamation is recognized when a node parent word refers to the node itself after an ordering barrier; descent, ascent, slot reads and successor searches all recheck this condition and on detection reset the cursor and restart from a saved index, with initial root acquisition retrying until a live root appears.

Descent chooses the first pivot at or beyond the sought position to narrow the interval, lower bounds derive from zero or one past the preceding pivot, pivotless nodes report zero length, otherwise length follows metadata when the final pivot is empty, the final position when it equals the caller maximum, else full category capacity; successor moves derive the enclosing maximum through bounded pivot lookup.

Vacancy summaries are maintained only for trees created in allocation tracking mode and never for a root link; writes that alter occupancy recompute the largest vacancy of the affected node, with a leaf specific computation for leaves and a gap array read at the recorded position for internal nodes.

A self test builds parallel interval and maple structures over randomized ranges, stores each interval into an allocation tracking tree in read side critical section mode, then advances both span iterators over identical queries including a full span probe and requires hole identity and corresponding boundaries to match on every step, ending with the maple cursor in overflow before destroying both structures.

Skipping grace or sequence validation risks acting on stale storage, sequence mismatch and unexpected termination raise one time warnings, parent decoding warns on root marked input, inverted intervals and reserved encodings are rejected, and an unexpected store category is treated as a fatal inconsistency.

Encoding facts: distinct masks clear tag and root marker bits from a link, a shift plus mask pair recovers the embedded category, a dedicated flag marks a root parent, a dedicated construction combines address, shifted category and null marker, and per category symbolic capacities bound pivot and slot counts.

Parent and range facts: separate masks and shifts decode narrow versus wide parent slot fields, separate patterns denote range parentage and root parentage, one option flag enables allocation tracking, full walks span from zero to the widest unsigned value, and a dedicated slot count marks empty and singleton positions.
